title: Color Belt · Screen 3 · “Both” in the top bar (CB13)
subtitle: Already decided (v1.022): on Both, Color Belt shows one box per school, the way Finance does (v0.198): “Both schools” under the title, each school's upcoming testing, and Open Worcester / Open Shrewsbury (they switch the whole dashboard, as today's buttons do). footer:
One question — private testings in the boxes?
A · Events only. + the smallest box; matches the change list's wording. − the desk can't see a private testing coming up at the other school without switching.
B · Recommended: events + one private-testing line (count and the next one). + everything Color Belt has coming at each school on one page; one short line, no names. − a second read per school, so the page loads a little more.
